detail.name: Farm Management Deposit - Fixed
detail.description: Our Farm Management Deposit accounts provide primary producers with the opportunity to shift pre-tax primary product income from years when it is needed least, to years when it is most needed, which could help you to manage exposure to adverse economic events and seasonal fluctuations.

features.additionalInfo: Make deposits and withdrawals to your account during the 7 day renewal grace period, day 1 is the maturity date (minimum deposit/withdrawal amount of $1,000 applies)
You must provide 31 days' notice for early withdrawal or termination before your fixed term Deposit Account matures
A fixed term Farm Management Deposit that pays competitive interest
Wide choice of terms, starting from 28 days to five years

Easy reinvestment, with automatic rollover at maturity for your choice of term (unless you've given us other instructions). You can choose the new lodgement term in advance. If you prefer, we'll notify you before your investment matures so you can make your choice based on current interest rates.
Choose when you receive your interest payments - either monthly or end of term
Access your funds prior to maturity, by simply providing 31 days prior notice to redeem your account early (an interest adjustment applies)
Interest is paid directly into another nominated account held by you with BOQ or another Australian Financial Institution

constraints.additionalInfo: Minimum investment amount and account balance is $1,000

eligibility.additionalInfo: The FMD Scheme is restricted to primary producers with a non-primary production income of $100,000 or less.
